title: The Supreme Court vs. Andy Warhol

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普林（Benjamin Poulin），我是马克·荣森（Mark Ronson），欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍贵的私人物品去上班，然后把DJ台变成一个像是充满美感的50年前艺术品的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔（Michael）。

sentences.en: If you listen to podcasts, which we know you do because you're here, you know that the biggest challenge is finding great stuff to listen to.
sentences.zh: 如果你听播客——我们知道你听，因为你就在这里——你就会知道最大的挑战是找到真正精彩的收听内容。

sentences.en: The Times wants to make that a lot easier.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》想要让这件事变得容易得多。

sentences.en: We're launching an audio app, NYT Audio, a single place where you can find the shows you already know and love, like The Daily, This American Life, Serial, The Run-Up,
sentences.zh: 我们正在推出一款音频应用 NYT Audio，这是一个集成了你已经了解并喜爱的节目的单一平台，比如《每日新闻》（The Daily）、《This American Life》、《Serial》、《The Run-Up》，

sentences.en: and discover a bunch of new shows that you can't get anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 并发现一堆你在其他地方找不到的新节目。

sentences.en: I want to introduce you to one of them.
sentences.zh: 我想向你介绍其中一个。

sentences.en: It's called The Headlines, and it pairs perfectly with The Daily.
sentences.zh: 它叫《头条新闻》（The Headlines），与《每日新闻》完美契合。

sentences.en: As you know, The Daily tells one big story a day, but The Times is covering dozens of stories a day with reporters across the world.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，《每日新闻》每天讲述一个重大故事，但《时报》的记者遍布世界各地，每天报道几十个故事。

sentences.en: And that's where The Headlines comes in.
sentences.zh: 这就是《头条新闻》切入的地方。

sentences.en: It captures even more news than The Daily does in just 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 它在短短10分钟内捕捉到的新闻甚至比《每日新闻》还要多。

sentences.en: And all this week, we're going to give you the headlines right here on The Daily feed.
sentences.zh: 而且就在本周，我们将在《每日新闻》的节目源里直接为你播报头条新闻。

sentences.en: After that, you can listen to it, along with The Daily, on the audio app.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，你可以在音频应用上收听它，以及《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: So how do you get this app?
sentences.zh: 那么，如何获取这款应用呢？

sentences.en: If you're a Times, News, or All Access subscriber, you can get it for free by going to nytimes.com slash audio app, or by searching NYT Audio in the App Store.
sentences.zh: 如果你是《时报》、《新闻》或全通订户（All Access subscriber），只需访问 nytimes.com/audioapp，或者在应用商店中搜索 NYT Audio，即可免费获取。

sentences.en: If you're not a subscriber, the app is the perfect reason to become one.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，这款应用绝对是让你成为订户的最佳理由。

sentences.en: And now, on to the show.
sentences.zh: 现在，进入今天的节目。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A few days ago, the Supreme Court tried to answer a question that has long bedeviled the world of art.
sentences.zh: 几天前，最高法院试图回答一个长期困扰艺术界的问题。

sentences.en: When is borrowing from an earlier artist an act of inspiration?
sentences.zh: 借鉴早期艺术家的作品，在什么时候是一种灵感的行为？

sentences.en: And when is it theft?
sentences.zh: 而又在什么时候属于盗窃？

sentences.en: Today, Adam Liptak on the case that could change how art is made.
sentences.zh: 今天，亚当·利普塔克（Adam Liptak）将带来可能改变艺术创作方式的案件报道。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月23日，星期二。

sentences.en: Adam, if you'll just indulge me for a moment.
sentences.zh: 亚当，如果你能稍微迁就我一下的话。

sentences.en: How would you describe your relationship to fine art?
sentences.zh: 你将如何形容你与纯艺术的关系？

sentences.en: I'm a dilettante.
sentences.zh: 我只是个业余爱好者。

sentences.en: My wife takes me to a lot of museuMs.
sentences.zh: 我太太带我去过很多博物馆。

sentences.en: I try to be a cultured person.
sentences.zh: 我努力让自己成为一个有文化的人。

sentences.en: That's noble.
sentences.zh: 这很崇高。

sentences.en: And what are your specific thoughts about Andy Warhol?
sentences.zh: 你对安迪·沃霍尔（Andy Warhol）有什么具体的看法吗？

sentences.en: You know, Warhol is so present in the popular culture, even though, you know, much of what he does is appropriate and comment on the culture of celebrity.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，沃霍尔在流行文化中无处不在，尽管你知道，他的许多做法都是在挪用和评论名流文化。

sentences.en: Even though, if I'm reading between my lines, not everyone, including you, even agrees that everything Warhol does is art.
sentences.zh: 尽管，如果我从字里行间来理解，并非所有人都——包括你在内——甚至都同意沃霍尔所做的一切都是艺术。

sentences.en: And just to give you my perspective on this, my experience with it, Warhol, for me, is a bath book that I read to my son, Ash.
sentences.zh: 为了让你了解我的视角和我的体验，对我而言，沃霍尔是一本我读给我儿子阿什（Ash）看的洗澡书。

sentences.en: If you get the pages wet, the pieces of art in the book, the Brillo pad boxes, the Campbell's soup cans, they turn a different shade of color.
sentences.zh: 如果你把书页弄湿，书中的艺术品——布里洛洗碗棉盒子（Brillo pad boxes）、坎贝尔汤罐头（Campbell's soup cans）——就会变成不同的色调。

sentences.en: I mean, this is how ubiquitous Andy Warhol has become.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，安迪·沃霍尔已经变得如此无处不在。

sentences.en: He is in the bathtub.
sentences.zh: 他甚至出现在了浴缸里。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, museums around the world display his work, and it's worth, cumulatively, hundreds of millions, if not a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，世界各地的博物馆都在展出他的作品，这些作品的总价值加起来有数亿美元，甚至高达十亿美元。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the reason we're talking to you about Warhol is not because we're here to debate the relative merits or valuations of his pieces,
sentences.zh: 我们找你谈论沃霍尔，并不是因为我们要在这里辩论他的作品的相对价值或估值，

sentences.en: but because he is the subject of a pretty important Supreme Court ruling, one that came down a few days ago and that I think got a little bit lost in the shuffle of the news.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他是最高法院一项相当重要的裁决的主角，这项裁决几天前刚刚作出，我认为它在新闻纷扰中有点被忽视了。

sentences.en: So tell us about that case.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这个案件吧。

sentences.en: So, you know, Michael, we often talk about the blockbuster cases involving huge social issues, abortion, affirmative action, gay rights, religion.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克尔，我们经常讨论涉及重大社会议题的重磅案件，比如堕胎、平权行动、同性恋权利、宗教。

sentences.en: But the court also can issue quite important consequential decisions about all kinds of areas of American life.
sentences.zh: 但法院也会就美国生活的方方面面发布相当重要且影响深远的决定。

sentences.en: And this case that came down a couple days ago involves a quite large question about what artists can do and how much they can make use of, draw on,
sentences.zh: 几天前做出的这起案件涉及一个相当宏大的问题：艺术家能做什么，他们能在多大程度上利用、借鉴、

sentences.en: engage in a conversation with earlier works, or whether that crosses a line of copyright infringement.
sentences.zh: 与早期作品展开对话，还是说这跨越了侵犯版权的红线。

sentences.en: In other words, the Supreme Court weighed in on when is art appropriation, when is it honorary borrowing, when is it theft?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，最高法院权衡了：什么时候艺术是挪用，什么时候是致敬式的借鉴，什么时候又是盗窃？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or when is it such a transformation that it's created something wholly new or protectable in its own right?
sentences.zh: 或者什么时候这种转化创造了全新且本身具有可保护性的东西？

sentences.en: And where does this case, Adam, begin?
sentences.zh: 亚当，这个案件是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: It starts in 1981 when the rock musician Prince is starting to get famous.
sentences.zh: 它始于1981年，当时摇滚音乐家普林斯（Prince）开始崭露头角。

sentences.en: His album Controversy comes out.
sentences.zh: 他的专辑《Controversy》发行了。

sentences.en: He hosts Saturday Night Live.
sentences.zh: 他主持了《周六夜现场》（Saturday Night Live）。

sentences.en: And now here's...
sentences.zh: 现在这里是……

sentences.en: And a prominent rock photographer, Lynn Goldsmith, thinks it's time to get some photographs of him.
sentences.zh: 一位知名的摇滚摄影师琳恩·戈德史密斯（Lynn Goldsmith）认为，是时候拍一些他的照片了。

sentences.en: She gets a commission from Newsweek magazine.
sentences.zh: 她接到了《新闻周刊》（Newsweek）杂志的委托。

sentences.en: She takes some concert photos and some portraits.
sentences.zh: 她拍摄了一些演唱会照片和肖像照。

sentences.en: And one portrait in particular, which will be at the center of this case, black and white, shows Prince kind of ill at ease, vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 其中有一张特别的肖像照，将成为本案的焦点，这是一张黑白照片，展现了普林斯那种局促不安、脆弱的状态。

sentences.en: It's a striking photograph of a young rock musician.
sentences.zh: 这是一张令人印象深刻的年轻摇滚音乐家照片。

sentences.en: A couple years later, 1984, Prince is turning into a superstar.
sentences.zh: 几年后的1984年，普林斯正在变成超级巨星。

sentences.en: His album Purple Rain is coming out.
sentences.zh: 他的专辑《Purple Rain》即将发行。

sentences.en: And Vanity Fair wants to do an article on him and asks Andy Warhol, the very prominent artist, to illustrate it.
sentences.zh: 《名利场》（Vanity Fair）想要做一篇关于他的文章，并邀请了知名艺术家安迪·沃霍尔来为之做插图。

sentences.en: And they obtained for Warhol one of Lynn Goldsmith's portraits as an artist's reference.
sentences.zh: 他们为沃霍尔获取了琳恩·戈德史密斯的一幅肖像画作为艺术家的参考。

sentences.en: They pay her 400 bucks and tell her they will use it once.
sentences.zh: 他们付给她400美元，并告诉她只会使用一次。

sentences.en: And Warhol gets to work and alters the photograph.
sentences.zh: 于是沃霍尔开始工作并修改了这张照片。

sentences.en: He kind of crops it.
sentences.zh: 他对其进行了裁剪。

sentences.en: He colors it purple.
sentences.zh: 他把它涂成紫色。

sentences.en: He sort of shades Prince's eyes.
sentences.zh: 他给普林斯的眼睛加了点阴影。

sentences.en: And it's a very different looking kind of disembodied head that art critics say is not that kind of lonely ill at ease portrait of Prince,
sentences.zh: 这是一个看起来非常不同的虚无头部形象，艺术评论家说这不再是那种孤独、局促不安的普林斯肖像，

sentences.en: but as a kind of view of modern celebrity, or so the art critics say.
sentences.zh: 而是一种对现代名流的看法，艺术评论家们是这么说的。

sentences.en: So Vanity Fair publishes that silkscreen image by Warhol based on the Goldsmith photo.
sentences.zh: 于是，《名利场》发表了沃霍尔根据戈德史密斯照片创作的丝网印刷图像。

sentences.en: Warhol also goes off and creates 15 other variations on the Goldsmith photo.
sentences.zh: 沃霍尔随后又创作了基于戈德史密斯照片的其他15个变体。

sentences.en: And this is common with Warhol.
sentences.zh: 这在沃霍尔的作品中很常见。

sentences.en: He will do various versions of photos of celebrities.
sentences.zh: 他会制作各种名人照片的版本。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Marylins, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 玛丽莲系列，等等。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then when Warhol dies in 1987, those images and all of his other artwork and all of the copyrights in them go to the Andy Warhol Foundation for Visual Arts.
sentences.zh: 然后在1987年沃霍尔去世时，这些图像以及他的所有其他艺术品和其中的所有版权都归了安迪·沃霍尔视觉艺术基金会（Andy Warhol Foundation for Visual Arts）。

sentences.en: Then in 2016, Prince himself dies and Vanity Fair's parent company, Condé Nast, puts together a special magazine celebrating Prince's life.
sentences.zh: 接着在2016年，普林斯本人去世了，《名利场》的母公司康泰纳仕（Condé Nast）制作了一本纪念普林斯一生的特刊。

sentences.en: And it wants to find a cover image and it goes to the Andy Warhol Foundation and says, what do you got?
sentences.zh: 它想要找一张封面图片，于是找到了安迪·沃霍尔基金会，问你们有什么？

sentences.en: And they take a different image from this series and put it on the cover and pay the foundation $10,000.
sentences.zh: 他们从这个系列中挑选了另一张图片放在了封面上，并付给基金会10,000美元。

sentences.en: And Lynn Goldsmith gets no money and no credit.
sentences.zh: 而琳恩·戈德史密斯一分钱也没拿到，也没有署名。

sentences.en: And when she becomes aware of this use of her work, she says, wait a second, that's copyright infringement.
sentences.zh: 当她发现她的作品被这样使用时，她说，等一下，这是侵犯版权。

sentences.en: You're not allowed to do that.
sentences.zh: 你们不能这样做。

sentences.en: And what does the Warhol Foundation have to say about that?
sentences.zh: 沃霍尔基金会对些有何回应？

sentences.en: The Warhol Foundation launches a lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 沃霍尔基金会提起了一场诉讼。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哦？

sentences.en: And what is their rationale for filing a lawsuit and making that argument?
sentences.zh: 他们提起诉讼并提出这一论点的理据是什么？

sentences.en: Because they could just have paid her off, right?
sentences.zh: 因为他们本可以直接把钱付给她，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, we're not privy to the settlement negotiations.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们不得而知和解谈判的内情。

sentences.en: But at the argument, the Warhol Foundation's lawyers said that Goldsmith had asked for a quite substantial seven-figure sum.
sentences.zh: 但在庭辩中，沃霍尔基金会的律师表示，戈德史密斯曾要求过一个相当庞大的七位数金额。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 唔。

sentences.en: But the lawsuit also has a larger purpose.
sentences.zh: 但这场诉讼也有一个更宏大的目的。

sentences.en: And it's a purpose that the Warhol Foundation has to care deeply about because it goes to the heart of Warhol's work.
sentences.zh: 这是一个沃霍尔基金会必须深切关心的目的，因为它触及了沃霍尔作品的核心。

sentences.en: And they want to make the case that under the copyright laws and under the so-called fair use exception to copyright infringement,
sentences.zh: 他们希望阐明这样一种观点：根据版权法以及所谓的版权侵权合理使用（fair use）例外原则，

sentences.en: it's important to create some space for later artists to make use of earlier works.
sentences.zh: 为后来的艺术家利用早期的作品创造一些空间是很重要的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So the Warhol Foundation is trying to make a point about the need to protect artistic expression that builds on, appropriates, and transforms earlier works.
sentences.zh: 因此，沃霍尔基金会试图阐明一种观点，即需要保护那些建立在早期作品基础之上、对其进行挪用和转化的艺术表达。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So for the Warhol Foundation, this is not about one payment, one lawsuit, one anything.
sentences.zh: 所以对沃霍尔基金会来说，这不只是一笔付款、一场诉讼或任何单一的事情。

sentences.en: This is a more existential question of whether an artist like Warhol gets to practice their craft, which involves borrowing and appropriating on a pretty large scale.
sentences.zh: 这是一个更具存在意义的问题，即像沃霍尔这样的艺术家是否能够行使他们的创作工艺——这涉及相当大规模的借用和挪用。

sentences.en: Well, that's right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实如此。

sentences.en: And the court has looked at this question in a slightly different context before.
sentences.zh: 法院以前也在稍微不同的语境下探讨过这个问题。

sentences.en: In 1994, in a case involving the rap group Two Live Crew and Roy Orbison, one of the founding fathers of rock and roll.
sentences.zh: 在1994年，在一个涉及说唱组合“两人生存说唱团”（Two Live Crew）与摇滚乐奠基人之一罗伊·奥比森（Roy Orbison）的案件中。

sentences.en: Pretty woman walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 漂亮女人走在街上。

sentences.en: Two Live Crew wanted to have some fun with the Roy Orbison hit Pretty Woman.
sentences.zh: Two Live Crew想要拿罗伊·奥比森的热门歌曲《Pretty Woman》开个玩笑。

sentences.en: And substitute other characters for Pretty Woman.
sentences.zh: 并用其他角色替代“漂亮女人”。

sentences.en: Big Hairy Woman.
sentences.zh: 大毛发女人。

sentences.en: Big Hairy Woman.
sentences.zh: 大毛发女人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And two-time in a woman.
sentences.zh: 还有双倍时间的女人。

sentences.en: I know the song.
sentences.zh: 我知道这首歌。

sentences.en: The owners of those rights, of the Orbison song, flatly said, no, we don't want to be involved in a parody that transforms a pretty woman into a hairy woman.
sentences.zh: 这些版权的所有者——奥比森歌曲的版权所有者——断然表示，不，我们不想参与将一个漂亮女人变成一个毛发蓬乱的女人的恶搞。

sentences.en: No, thank you.
sentences.zh: 不，谢谢。

sentences.en: Two Live Crew does it anyway, takes its chances, has a big hit.
sentences.zh: Two Live Crew还是照做了，放手一搏，大获成功。

sentences.en: They get sued.
sentences.zh: 他们被起诉了。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court said, well, if it's parody, that's in the nature of fair use.
sentences.zh: 最高法院表示，好吧，如果是恶搞，那就属于合理使用的范畴。

sentences.en: That comment, criticism, parody gets protected because otherwise you couldn't do it at all.
sentences.zh: 这种评论、批评和恶搞会受到保护，因为否则你就根本无法进行创作。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, from where the Warhol Foundation sits,
sentences.zh: 所以，站在沃霍尔基金会的立场来看，

sentences.en: it looks like a very big and very important precedent case that it can call upon in its dispute with Lynn Goldsmith would seem to favor Warhol's approach to art,
sentences.zh: 在与琳恩·戈德史密斯的纠纷中，似乎有一个非常重大且非常重要的判例可以引用，它似乎倾向于沃霍尔的艺术方法，

sentences.en: which is cumulative.
sentences.zh: 也就是累积性的。

sentences.en: It is borrowish.
sentences.zh: 它是借用式的。

sentences.en: It is what Two Live Crew did to Roy Orbison.
sentences.zh: 这正是Two Live Crew对罗伊·奥比森所做的事情。

sentences.en: So, that's mostly right, although there may be a key distinction.
sentences.zh: 所以，大体上是这样，尽管可能存在一个关键的区别。

sentences.en: Where Two Live Crew is engaging with and commenting on the earlier work, it's not clear that Warhol is saying anything about the Goldsmith photo.
sentences.zh: 在Two Live Crew参与和评论早期作品的地方，目前尚不清楚沃霍尔是否在对戈德史密斯照片表达任何看法。

sentences.en: He's using it, yes.
sentences.zh: 他的确使用了它，是的。

sentences.en: But is he actually engaging with it?
sentences.zh: 但他真的在与它对话吗？

sentences.en: Is he actually saying something about it?
sentences.zh: 他真的在表达关于它的什么内容吗？

sentences.en: Or could he just have easily gone to any other photograph of Prince to do his Warhol number on that photograph?
sentences.zh: 或者他完全可以轻而易举地去找普林斯的任何其他照片来施展他的沃霍尔魔法？

sentences.en: So, there's some real gray area in this Warhol lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个沃霍尔诉讼案中存在一些真正的灰色地带。

sentences.en: So, tell us about the oral arguments in this case once it hits the nine justices of the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们讲讲这个案件一旦提交到最高法院九位大法官面前时的口头辩论情况吧。

sentences.en: We will hear argument first this morning in case number 21869, Andy Warhol Foundation versus Goldsmith.
sentences.zh: 今天上午我们首先听取第21-869号案件的辩论，安迪·沃霍尔基金会诉戈德史密斯案。

sentences.en: Mr. Martinez?
sentences.zh: 马丁内斯先生？

sentences.en: Mr. Chief Justice, and may it please the court.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官阁下，法官大人，大家好。

sentences.en: So, the lawyer for the Warhol Foundation, Roman Martinez, makes two basic points, one focused and one quite large.
sentences.zh: 因此，沃霍尔基金会的律师罗曼·马丁内斯（Roman Martinez）提出了两个基本观点，一个是聚焦的，另一个是相当宏大的。

sentences.en: Warhol's Prince series can reasonably be perceived to convey a fundamentally different meaning or message from Goldsmith's photograph.
sentences.zh: 沃霍尔的普林斯系列可以被合理地认为传达了与戈德史密斯照片根本不同的含义或信息。

sentences.en: The focused argument is that he maintains that all you need to do is look at the Warhol piece, and you will see that it conveys a fundamentally different message,
sentences.zh: 聚焦的论点是，他坚称你所需要做的就是看看沃霍尔的作品，你就会明白它传达了一个根本不同的信息，

sentences.en: that its meaning is different from the photograph, and that it should be protected for that reason.
sentences.zh: 它的含义与照片不同，并应因此受到保护。

sentences.en: Finally, the stakes for artistic expression in this case are high.
sentences.zh: 最后，本案对艺术表达的利害关系是重大的。

sentences.en: His larger point is that it's not about one image of Prince.
sentences.zh: 他更宏大的观点是，这不单关乎普林斯的某一个形象。

sentences.en: It's about the nature of how art works.
sentences.zh: 这关乎艺术运作的本质。

sentences.en: A ruling for Goldsmith would strip protection not just from this Prince series, but from countless works of modern and contemporary art.
sentences.zh: 对戈德史密斯有利的裁决将剥夺保护，不仅剥夺这个普林斯系列的保护，还将剥夺无数现代和当代艺术作品的保护。

sentences.en: And that lots of visual and other kinds of art, music, literature, works because the later work is building on, commenting on, in dialogue with the earlier work.
sentences.zh: 许多视觉艺术和其他类型的艺术——音乐、文学——之所以能够运作，是因为后来的作品建立在早期作品的基础之上，对其进行评论，并与早期作品进行对话。

sentences.en: It would make it illegal for artists, museums, galleries, and collectors to display, sell, profit from, maybe even possess a significant quantity of works.
sentences.zh: 这将使艺术家、博物馆、画廊和收藏家展示、出售、从中获利甚至拥有相当数量的作品成为非法行为。

sentences.en: And for the Supreme Court to say that the copyright law is so rigid that it doesn't allow for that kind of expression would do grave damage to the artistic community.
sentences.zh: 如果最高法院裁定版权法如此僵化，以至于不容许这种表达，将对艺术界造成严重的损害。

sentences.en: Not just damage to Warhol, but basically to any artist who does what Warhol does, of which there are thousands.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是对沃霍尔的损害，基本上是对所有做沃霍尔那种创作的艺术家的损害，这样的人有成千上万。

sentences.en: Yes, certainly visual art, but also all kinds of art.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然包括视觉艺术，但也包括各种艺术。

sentences.en: And what about the other side?
sentences.zh: 那另一方怎么说呢？

sentences.en: Adam, what do lawyers for Lynn Goldsmith tell the justices?
sentences.zh: 亚当，林·戈尔茨的律师对大法官们说了什么？

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chief Justice, and may it please the court.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，首席大法官阁下，请允许我开始辩论。

sentences.en: Goldsmith's lawyer, Lisa Blatt, says the question isn't whether Warhol was a genius or an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 戈德史密斯的律师莉萨·布拉特说，问题不在于沃霍尔是否是个天才或艺术家。

sentences.en: The question was whether he or his foundation should have paid Goldsmith when he built on her work.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，当他在她的作品基础上进行创作时，他或他的基金会是否应该向戈德史密斯付费。

sentences.en: That there should be no kind of Warhol exception for this genius.
sentences.zh: 对于这位天才，不应该有什么沃霍尔式的特例。

sentences.en: Petitioner responds, Warhol is a creative genius who imbued other people's art with his own distinctive style.
sentences.zh: 上诉方回应称，沃霍尔是一位富有创造力的天才，他将自己独特的风格注入了别人的艺术之中。

sentences.en: But Spielberg did the same for films and Jimi Hendrix for music.
sentences.zh: 但斯皮尔伯格对电影、吉米·亨德里克斯对音乐也做了同样的事。

sentences.en: Those giants still needed licenses.
sentences.zh: 这些巨匠仍然需要获得授权。

sentences.en: She had this nice phrase, copyrights will be at the mercy of copycats if the court rules for Warhol.
sentences.zh: 她有一句很好的表述：如果法院判沃霍尔胜诉，版权将任由抄袭者宰割。

sentences.en: Anyone could turn Darth Vader into a hero or spin off All in the Family into the Jeffersons without paying the creators a dime.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以把达斯·维达变成英雄，或者把《全家福》衍生出《杰斐逊一家》，而不用向创作者支付一分钱。

sentences.en: I welcome to your questions.
sentences.zh: 欢迎大家提问。

sentences.en: So both sides seem to be making the most extreme arguments they can think of.
sentences.zh: 所以双方似乎都提出了他们能想到的最极端的论点。

sentences.en: And the justices, as they weigh in on the case, also seem to be staking out quite extreme positions.
sentences.zh: 而大法官们在介入这起案件时，似乎也表明了相当极端的立场。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶唱片时代的光盘夜总会当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面摆满了美丽的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听由爱彼呈献的《重构者》。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨四点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 探索太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 庆祝175周年，帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，即可在 nytimes.com slash subscribe 享受优惠。

sentences.en: So Adam, during the oral arguments in this case, what do the justices have to say about Warhol, Goldsmith, and the merits of this case?
sentences.zh: 那么，亚当，在该案的口头辩论期间，大法官们对沃霍尔、戈尔茨密斯以及本案的案情有什么看法？

sentences.en: There are basically two schools of thought.
sentences.zh: 基本上有两种思想流派。

sentences.en: A couple of the justices, and they're not typically allies, really seem to be taken by the quality of Warhol's art and suggest that at least when we're talking about Andy Warhol,
sentences.zh: 有几位大法官——他们通常不是盟友——似乎真的很欣赏沃霍尔的艺术品质，并暗示至少当我们讨论安迪·沃霍尔时，

sentences.en: you really ought to let him have some room to maneuver.
sentences.zh: 你真的应该给他留出一些活动空间。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Which justices?
sentences.zh: 哪几位大法官？

sentences.en: Well, Chief Justice John Roberts and Justice Kagan.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨和卡根大法官。

sentences.en: Ms. Blatt, you said that the only thing that's different was the distinctive style of Warhol.
sentences.zh: 布拉特女士，你说唯一不同的是沃霍尔独特的风格。

sentences.en: I think your friend's point is broader than that.
sentences.zh: 我认为你朋友的观点比这更广泛。

sentences.en: Roberts completely buys in to the idea that Warhol is sending a different message.
sentences.zh: 罗伯茨完全赞同沃霍尔传达了不同信息的观点。

sentences.en: It's not just that Warhol has a different style.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是沃霍尔有不同的风格。

sentences.en: It's that unlike Goldsmith's photograph, Warhol sends a message about the depersonalization of modern culture and celebrity status.
sentences.zh: 而是与戈尔茨密斯的照片不同，沃霍尔传达了一个关于现代文化非个性化和名人地位的信息。

sentences.en: So it's not just a different style.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是不同的风格。

sentences.en: It's a different purpose.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不同的目的。

sentences.en: One is the commentary on modern society.
sentences.zh: 一个是针对现代社会的评论。

sentences.en: The other is to show what prints looks like.
sentences.zh: 另一个是展示版画长什么样。

sentences.en: And Kagan, in slightly more colloquial terms, asked the question of how come museums all over the world have Warhol's in them.
sentences.zh: 卡根则用更通俗的语言提问，为什么全世界的博物馆里都有沃霍尔的作品。

sentences.en: The point is, why do museums show Andy Warhol?
sentences.zh: 重点是，为什么博物馆要展出安迪·沃霍尔的作品？

sentences.en: They show Andy Warhol because he was a transformative artist, because he took a bunch of photographs and he made them mean something completely different.
sentences.zh: 他们展出安迪·沃霍尔是因为他是一位具有变革意义的艺术家，因为他拍摄了一组照片并赋予了它们完全不同的含义。

sentences.en: And people look at Elvis and people look at Marilyn Monroe or Elizabeth Taylor and prints,
sentences.zh: 人们看着埃尔维斯，看着玛丽莲·梦露或伊丽莎白·泰勒及其版画，

sentences.en: and they say this has an entirely different message from the thing that started it all off.
sentences.zh: 他们会说这与最初的东西有着完全不同的信息。

sentences.en: That suggests that the answer to the question in the case, at least in the case of Warhol, she says, is that he ought to be protected.
sentences.zh: 这表明，对于本案中问题的答案，至少在沃霍尔这个案子上，她说，他是应该受到保护的。

sentences.en: So what Roberts and Kagan are communicating here, besides the fact that they seem to have taken art history in college and want everyone to know it,
sentences.zh: 因此，罗伯茨和卡根在这里传达的信息——除了他们似乎在大学里学过艺术史并希望所有人都知道这一点之外——

sentences.en: is that Warhol's take on the original print's photo is not at all a copycat.
sentences.zh: 是沃霍尔对原始版画照片的处理根本不是抄袭。

sentences.en: And that's legally meaningful here, given the precedence and given the nature of the case.
sentences.zh: 鉴于判例和案件性质，这在法律上具有重要意义。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And other justices spoke in less highfalutin terms and were more skeptical of the Warhol Foundation's arguments.
sentences.zh: 其他大法官则用没那么高高在上的语气发言，对沃霍尔基金会的论点更加怀疑。

sentences.en: And Justice Alito, for instance, asked...
sentences.zh: 例如，阿利托大法官问道……

sentences.en: How is a court to determine the purpose or meaning of works of art, like a photograph or a painting?
sentences.zh: 法院该如何确定艺术品（如照片或绘画）的目的或意义？

sentences.en: How am I supposed to decide what the meaning of an artwork is?
sentences.zh: 我该如何决定一件艺术品的意义是什么？

sentences.en: Because that's, you know, not what I learned in law school.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，这不是我在法学院学到的东西。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And the lawyer for the Warhol Foundation says, well, let's look at the Two Live Crew case.
sentences.zh: 沃霍尔基金会的律师说，好吧，让我们看看“两重唱”乐队（Two Live Crew）的案子。

sentences.en: One of the issues in the case was whether the Two Live Crew song was in fact a parody.
sentences.zh: 该案的争议焦点之一是“两重唱”乐队的歌曲是否确实是恶搞。

sentences.en: And in order to do that, the court needed to assess what the meaning or message of the work was.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，法院需要评估作品的意义或信息是什么。

sentences.en: So I think you could just look at the two works and figure out what you think.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你可以看看这两件作品，然后弄清楚你的想法。

sentences.en: He says, back then, the court looked at the song and decided it had a meaning that was distinct from, but transformed, the Roy Orbison song.
sentences.zh: 他说，当时法院查看了这首歌，并断定它的含义既独立于罗伊·奥尔ビ森（Roy Orbison）的歌曲，又对其进行了转化。

sentences.en: And that's judicial work.
sentences.zh: 这就是司法工作。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You make it sound simple, but maybe it's not so simple, at least in some cases, to determine what is the meaning or the message of a work of art.
sentences.zh: 你把它说得很简单，但也许并非如此简单，至少在某些情况下，要确定一件艺术品的意义或信息并不容易。

sentences.en: There can be a lot of dispute about what the meaning or the message is.
sentences.zh: 对于其意义或信息是什么，可能会有很多争议。

sentences.en: And Alito says, you make it sound easy, but I'm not sure we're really up to the job.
sentences.zh: 阿利托说，你把它说得很轻松，但我不太确定我们是否真的能胜任这项工作。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Alito is saying, I'm not comfortable declaring this to be such a transformation of the original artwork that I can sympathize with Warhol the way Kagan and Roberts have.
sentences.zh: 所以阿利托的意思是，我不认为这足以构成对原作的大幅转化，以至于我能像卡根和罗伯茨那样对沃霍尔产生共鸣。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And other justices, also hostile to the Warhol Foundation, like Justices Sonia Sotomayor and Neil Gorsuch, are focused on the practical questions in the case.
sentences.zh: 其他同样对沃霍尔基金会持敌意的大法官，如索尼娅·索托马约尔和尼尔·戈萨奇，则关注本案中的实际问题。

sentences.en: The particular transactions between Vanity Fair and Condé NaSt.
sentences.zh: 名利场和康泰纳仕之间的特定交易。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And what does Sotomayor have to say?
sentences.zh: 索托马约尔是怎么说的？

sentences.en: The specific use was of this one part of the Prince series, only one level of it, as a photograph in the life of Prince.
sentences.zh: 具体的使用是王子（Prince）系列中这一部分的使用，仅仅是其中一个层面，作为《王子的一生》中的一张照片。

sentences.en: Now, that use, you say on Factor 4, that it doesn't compete with Goldsmith's photograph, but hard to see how not.
sentences.zh: 现在，关于这种使用，你在要素4上说它不与戈尔茨密斯的照片竞争，但很难看出为什么不竞争。

sentences.en: Sotomayor says what's really at issue here is a narrow marketplace.
sentences.zh: 索托马约尔说，这里真正的问题是一个狭窄的市场。

sentences.en: They both sell photographs to magazines, and they both sell photographs to magazines to display Prince's vision or Prince's look.
sentences.zh: 他们都向杂志出售照片，而且他们都向杂志出售照片来展现王子的愿景或王子的外表。

sentences.en: It's the marketplace of selling pictures of Prince to magazines.
sentences.zh: 这就是向杂志出售王子照片的市场。

sentences.en: And you could argue about all kinds of other uses of what Warhol can do and can't do, but if Lynn Goldsmith can sell photographs of Prince to magazines,
sentences.zh: 你可以争论沃霍尔能做什么和不能做什么的各种其他用途，但如果林·戈尔茨密斯能够向杂志出售王子的照片，

sentences.en: and Andy Warhol is selling a photograph of Prince created by Lynn Goldsmith with some Warhol stuff on top of it to magazines, that, she says, is too close for comfort.
sentences.zh: 而安迪·沃霍尔正在向杂志出售一张由林·戈尔茨密斯创作、上面加了一些沃霍尔元素的王子照片，她说，这未免太雷同了。

sentences.en: That, she says, is what copyright is meant to protect your opportunity to sell your work in the same marketplace as the other guy.
sentences.zh: 她说，这就是版权旨在保护的东西——你有机会在与对方相同的市场中出售你的作品。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: In other words, they're both taking water out of the same well, and she isn't worried about some grand artistic idea.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们都在同一口井里取水，而她并不关心什么宏大的艺术理念。

sentences.en: Sotomayor is saying that Warhol has borrowed from a Goldsmith photo, sold to a magazine,
sentences.zh: 索托马约尔是在说，沃霍尔借鉴了戈尔茨密斯的一张照片并将其出售给了一杂志，

sentences.en: and then used a derivative piece of art to kind of muscle his way back into that same magazine marketplace.
sentences.zh: 然后利用一件衍生艺术品重新挤回了同一个杂志市场。

sentences.en: And thereby, he's basically stealing food from her table.
sentences.zh: 因此，他基本上是在抢夺她的饭碗。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, by the end of the argument, it seemed that a majority, maybe a lopsided majority of the court, was prepared to rule for Goldsmith.
sentences.zh: 因此，到辩论结束时，似乎大多数人，也许是压倒多数的大法官，都准备判决戈尔茨密斯胜诉。

sentences.en: Okay, so walk us through the ultimate ruling in this case.
sentences.zh: 好的，请为我们介绍一下本案的最终裁决。

sentences.en: So, in the end, the ruling was 7-2 in favor of Goldsmith.
sentences.zh: 最终，裁决结果以7比2支持戈尔茨密斯。

sentences.en: Justice Sotomayor writes the majority opinion, and it kind of tracks her questioning at the argument,
sentences.zh: 索托马约尔大法官撰写了多数意见书，这有点呼应她在辩论时的提问，

sentences.en: which focused on whether the Warhol Foundation was required to pay a fee to Goldsmith, at least in the context of licensing images to magazines.
sentences.zh: 其重点是沃霍尔基金会是否被要求向戈尔茨密斯支付费用，至少在向杂志授权图像的背景下是这样。

sentences.en: If you're selling pictures of prints to magazines, and you're in the same lane as the photographer whose work you were drawing on,
sentences.zh: 如果你在向杂志出售王子的照片，并且你和你所借鉴作品的摄影师处于同一赛道，

sentences.en: you have an obligation under the copyright laws to compensate her.
sentences.zh: 根据版权法，你就有义务向她进行赔偿。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: She says to hold otherwise would potentially authorize a range of commercial copying of photographs to be used for purposes that are substantially the same as those of the originals.
sentences.zh: 她说，如果不这样判决，可能会授权一系列商业复制照片的行为，而这些照片的用途与原作基本相同。

sentences.en: So, the majority's ruling here is that this is ultimately a kind of small-scale copyright infringement, and Warhol owes Goldsmith money.
sentences.zh: 因此，多数派在此案中的裁决是，这归根结底是一种小规模的版权侵权，沃霍尔欠戈尔茨密斯钱。

sentences.en: But I'm struck by the language that Sotomayor uses, substantially the same.
sentences.zh: 但我对索托马约尔使用的“基本相同”这个词印象深刻。

sentences.en: She's kind of taking the position that what Warhol did wasn't ultimately all that transformational of Goldsmith's original photograph.
sentences.zh: 她实际上持这样的立场：沃霍尔所做的事情最终并没有对戈尔茨密斯的原始照片进行那么大的转化。

sentences.en: That's right, and she's called out on that by the two dissenters, Chief Justice Roberts and Justice Kagan, that Sotomayor really minimizes what Warhol has done here.
sentences.zh: 没错，两位异议者——首席大法官罗伯茨和卡根大法官——对这一点提出了质疑，他们认为索托马约尔确实贬低了沃霍尔在这里所做的事情。

sentences.en: And Justice Kagan, who wrote the dissent, was quite slashing in criticizing what she viewed as a failure of imagination or taste or something by the majority.
sentences.zh: 撰写异议书的卡根大法官在批评她认为多数派缺乏想象力、品味或某种东西时，措辞相当严厉。

sentences.en: She wrote, the majority does not see it.
sentences.zh: 她写道，多数派没有看到这一点。

sentences.en: And I mean that literally.
sentences.zh: 我是字面意思上的意思。

sentences.en: There is precious little evidence in today's opinion that the majority has actually looked at these images,
sentences.zh: 今天的意见书中几乎没有什么证据表明多数派实际上看过这些图像，

sentences.en: much less that it has engaged with expert views of their aesthetics and meaning.
sentences.zh: 更不用说他们参与探讨了这些图像的美学和意义的专家观点。

sentences.en: Kagan also, she says, the majority decision will stifle creativity of every sort.
sentences.zh: 卡根还说，多数派的决定将扼杀各种形式的创造力。

sentences.en: It will impede new art and music and literature.
sentences.zh: 它将阻碍新的艺术、音乐和文学的发展。

sentences.en: It will thwart the expression of new ideas and the attainment of new knowledge.
sentences.zh: 它将阻碍新思想的表达和新知识的获得。

sentences.en: It will make our world poorer.
sentences.zh: 它将使我们的世界变得更加贫乏。

sentences.en: So just as the majority tries to make the case small, the dissent says it's huge.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如多数派试图将案件缩小一样，异议派则认为事关重大。

sentences.en: Well, let's interrogate that prediction from Justice Kagan.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们剖析一下卡根大法官的这个预测。

sentences.en: What does this ruling mean for the world of art?
sentences.zh: 这一裁决对艺术世界意味着什么？

sentences.en: If Kagan and Roberts are, to be believed, from that dissent, it will have a lasting and quite negative impact.
sentences.zh: 如果相信卡根和罗伯茨在异议书中的观点，它将产生持久且相当负面的影响。

sentences.en: My understanding is it's too soon to tell.
sentences.zh: 据我理解，现在下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: The majority certainly tried to write it in a small and focused way, concentrating on commercial transactions in the same lane.
sentences.zh: 多数派当然试图以一种微小而专注的方式来撰写它，专注于同一赛道上的商业交易。

sentences.en: But almost all of art consists of commercial transactions.
sentences.zh: 但几乎所有的艺术都包含商业交易。

sentences.en: And what the impact of the decision will be will turn on whether the original artists and the later artists are working in the same lane.
sentences.zh: 该裁决的影响将取决于原艺术家和后来的艺术家是否在同一赛道上工作。

sentences.en: And we don't know yet how broad those lanes are.
sentences.zh: 而我们还不知道这些赛道有多宽。

sentences.en: Or how narrow those lanes are.
sentences.zh: 或者这些赛道有多窄。

sentences.en: Right, so think about it this way.
sentences.zh: 对，所以可以这样想。

sentences.en: Hanging one of the Prince series images in a museum, probably not the same commercial lane.
sentences.zh: 在博物馆里悬挂王子系列的一幅图像，可能不在同一个商业赛道上。

sentences.en: But what about the postcard in the gift shop?
sentences.zh: 但礼品店里的明信片呢？

sentences.en: A postcard of one of these Prince images that's hanging in the museum.
sentences.zh: 挂在博物馆里的这些王子图像之一的明信片。

sentences.en: The museum may well also have postcards of Lynn Goldsmith's work.
sentences.zh: 博物馆很可能也会出售林·戈尔茨密斯作品的明信片。

sentences.en: She's a noted, prominent rock photographer.
sentences.zh: 她是一位知名、杰出的摇滚摄影师。

sentences.en: Does that mean that in that setting, we're also again in the same lane?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着在这种情况下，我们又回到了同一赛道？

sentences.en: And Goldsmith is entitled to a cut of the Warhol postcard.
sentences.zh: 并且戈尔茨密斯有权从沃霍尔的明信片中分得一杯羹。

sentences.en: By the legal test set up by the majority, it seems that it would.
sentences.zh: 根据多数派设定的法律检验标准，似乎确实如此。

sentences.en: You would think so, yeah.
sentences.zh: 你也会这么认为，是的。

sentences.en: And the dissenters are saying that is a can of worms you don't want to open.
sentences.zh: 异议者则表示，这是一个你不想打开的潘多拉魔盒。

sentences.en: Right, the dissenters say it will affect not only visual artists, but writers and musicians and filmmakers.
sentences.zh: 没错，异议者表示，这不仅会影响视觉艺术家，还会影响作家、音乐家和电影制作人。

sentences.en: And some of them will try to license the underlying work that they want to build on and won't be able to afford that license fee.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人会试图获得他们想要在其基础上进行创作的基础作品的授权，但却负担不起授权费用。

sentences.en: Or maybe we'll be told that the underlying works owner is not interested in licensing something.
sentences.zh: 或者有人会告诉我们，基础作品的拥有者对授权某事不感兴趣。

sentences.en: And some others are going to think, I would like to create new art that draws on old art, but I'm scared and I'm going to go do something else instead.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人会想，我想创作借鉴旧艺术的新艺术，但我很害怕，所以我还是去做别的吧。

sentences.en: So there is good reason to think that Justice Kagan's dissent might be a little overblown.
sentences.zh: 因此，有充分的理由认为卡根大法官的异议可能有点夸大其词了。

sentences.en: But at least at the margins, it might stifle some valuable artwork.
sentences.zh: 但至少在边缘情况下，它可能会扼杀一些有价值的艺术品。

sentences.en: But of course, there's another way to see this outcome, Adam,
sentences.zh: 不过当然了，还有另一种看待这个结果的角度，亚当，

sentences.en: which is that a new generation of artists born into the aftermath of a ruling like this sees borrowing from previous artists as too risky.
sentences.zh: 那就是，在经历这种裁决后出生新一代艺术家，会认为借鉴前人的艺术风险太高。

sentences.en: And it unleashes a wave of original creative art and music and literature that is not as reliant on everyone and everything from the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这将会引发一波原创创意艺术、音乐和文学浪潮，它们不再那么依赖过去的人和事。

sentences.en: I would call that the glass half full interpretation of the Supreme Court case.
sentences.zh: 我称之为对最高法院案件的乐观主义解读。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That is a very nice, optimistic idea that's at odds with millennia of experience of how art works.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常美好、乐观的想法，但它与数千年艺术创作经验相悖。

sentences.en: Well, Adam, the risk of being very derivative of what I say at the end of every episode.
sentences.zh: 好吧，亚当，我冒着在我每集结尾说的话上变得非常陈腐的风险。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulain and I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《The Reframers》，这是一档专注于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍贵的私人物品去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美艺术品的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 赶快在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《The Reframers》吧。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘文娜。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》这款游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有种叫联觉的病症。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: With just days left before the U.S.
sentences.zh: 距离美国

sentences.en: hits the debt ceiling and can no longer pay its bills,
sentences.zh: 触及债务上限且无力支付账单仅剩几天时间之际，

sentences.en: negotiators for Democrats and Republicans are increasingly focused on the idea of spending caps,
sentences.zh: 民主党和共和党的谈判代表越来越关注设定支出上限的想法，

sentences.en: which would limit future spending as the basis for a deal that would raise the debt ceiling and end the crisis.
sentences.zh: 这将限制未来的支出，作为提高债务上限和结束危机协议的基础。

sentences.en: Such spending caps, if agreed to by both sides, would allow Republicans to claim they have won spending concessions from Democrats
sentences.zh: 如果双方达成一致，此类支出上限将允许共和党人声称他们赢得了民主党的支出让步，

sentences.en: and allow Democrats to argue they're being fiscally responsible without letting Republicans slash spending on cherished domestic prograMs.
sentences.zh: 并允许民主党人辩称他们在负财政责任，同时又不让共和党人大幅削减备受珍视的国内项目支出。

sentences.en: Without a deal, the United States will hit the debt ceiling next week.
sentences.zh: 如果没有达成协议，美国将于下周触及债务上限。

sentences.en: And on Monday, the European Union fined Meta, the parent company of Facebook,
sentences.zh: 周一，欧盟对脸书的母公司 Meta 处以

sentences.en: $1.3 billion and ordered the company to stop transferring data collected in Europe to the United States.
sentences.zh: 13亿美元的罚款，并命令该公司停止将欧洲收集的数据传输到美国。

sentences.en: The EU found that Meta had failed to comply with a 2020 ruling that European data shipped to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 欧盟发现 Meta 未能遵守2020年的裁决，该裁决认为运往美国的欧洲数据

sentences.en: was not sufficiently protected from American spy agencies.
sentences.zh: 未能受到免受美国间谍机构侵害的充分保护。

sentences.en: Meta said it will appeal the fine.
sentences.zh: Meta 表示将对罚款提出上诉。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko, Diana Wynn and Sidney Harper.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科、黛安娜·韦恩和西德尼·哈珀制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by John Ketchum and M.J.
sentences.zh: 由约翰·凯彻姆和 M·J

sentences.en: Davis-Lynn, contains original music by Dan Powell and Alisha B'Etoop, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩编辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和艾丽莎·贝图普的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由仙境乐队的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《The Daily》的全部内容。

sentences.en: And just a reminder, all this week, you're going to see our new show, The Headlines, right here in The Daily Feed.
sentences.zh: 顺便提醒一下，整个这周，你都将在《The Daily Feed》中看到我们的新节目《The Headlines》。

sentences.en: We made it for you.
sentences.zh: 这是我们为你制作的。

sentences.en: Hope you like it.
sentences.zh: 希望你喜欢。

sentences.en: To find it, go to nytimes.com slash audio app.
sentences.zh: 要找到它，请访问 nytimes.com/audioapp。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bobarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·波巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《The Reframers》，这是一档专注于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍贵的私人物品去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美艺术品的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 赶快在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《The Reframers》吧。
